about: Sanctions status toward Russia since February 2022 for every entry in site/data.json. Neutral, verifiable parts; nothing inferred where no source was found. See sanctions_r58-notes.md.

categories.eu_member: EU member state: applies the EU's Russia sanctions (Council Regulations 833/2014, 269/2014), which it agreed to in the Council.
categories.adopts_eu_measures: Not in the EU; adopts the EU's Russia measures under its own law (named in EU alignment statements, or national decisions saying so). '_partial' in eu_aligned.status where official sources say alignment is incomplete.
categories.own_regime: Has its own Russia sanctions or export-control regime under national law (scope varies: Korea and Taiwan mainly export controls).
categories.financial_directive_only: Financial regulators directed institutions to observe other jurisdictions' Russia sanctions; no own designation list found (the Bahamas).
categories.no_own_regime_stated: No own regime found, and the government has said publicly that it does not impose sanctions of its own (statement in `position`).
categories.no_own_regime_found: No own Russia sanctions regime found on the date checked. This is not a statement about compliance with other countries' sanctions.
categories.territory_uk_order: British overseas territory covered by the Russia (Sanctions) (Overseas Territories) Order 2020: the UK regime applies there.
categories.territory: Not a sovereign state; status follows the sovereign only where its law extends there, which was not checked territory by territory.

unfriendly_list_text.order: Government of Russia Order of 5 March 2022 No. 430-r, as amended 23 July 2022 (2018-r) and 29 October 2022 (3216-r); current edition 29.10.2022 per ConsultantPlus on 2026-10-27
entries: United Kingdom (incl. Crown Dependencies and British Overseas Territories; Jersey, Anguilla, BVI, Gibraltar named from 5 March 2022, Guernsey and Isle of Man from 23 July 2022, all from 29 October 2022)
unfriendly_list_text.not_this_list: A separate Russian list (Presidential Decree 243 of 2021; Order 1230-r of 2021: USA, Czech Republic; extended July 2022 to Greece, Denmark, Slovenia, Croatia, Slovakia) limits hiring of local staff by diplomatic missions. Not used here; only search extracts were seen.
